title: Last Secure Code Benchmark: Is the Code You Vibe Secure?
abstract: arXiv:2610.14766v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI coding agents now write much of the code that ships, yet whether that code is secure remains unclear. We introduce the Last Secure Code Benchmark, a comprehensive evaluation of secure code generation by coding agents. Built from 150 real vulnerabilities, its 450 tasks span seven widely used languages (Java, C, C++, JavaScript, Python, PHP, and Go), 24 CWEs including 21 of the 2025 CWE Top 25 and 8 of the Top 10 KEV weaknesses, more than any benchmark we compare with, and three vibe-coding scenarios: filling in a function, writing a file, and building a repository's source tree from scratch. Every task asks only for functionality, through a specification that never mentions security, and hidden functional and security tests grade the result. translated_title: Last Secure Code基准：你“氛围编程”写出的代码安全吗？
translated_abstract: AI编程智能体现在编写了大量实际发布的代码，但这些代码是否安全仍不清楚。我们提出了Last Secure Code Benchmark，这是对编程智能体安全代码生成能力的全面评估。该基准基于150个真实漏洞构建，包含450个任务，涵盖七种广泛使用的语言（Java、C、C++、JavaScript、Python、PHP和Go）、24个CWE漏洞类型（包括2025年CWE Top 25中的21个和Top 10 KEV漏洞中的8个，多于我们所比较的任何基准），以及三种“氛围编程”场景：填充函数、编写文件和从零构建代码仓库的源代码树。每个任务仅通过从未提及安全性的规范来要求功能性，并由隐藏的功能测试和安全测试对结果进行评分。在六个前沿智能体中，73.6%至91.3%的任务能通过功能测试，然而即使是最强的Claude Fable 5，也只有25.1%的任务能生成既功能正常又安全的代码。
tldr: 该论文提出了基于150个真实漏洞、涵盖7种编程语言和3种vibe coding场景的Last Secure Code Benchmark，发现前沿AI编程智能体虽然功能测试通过率高达73.6%–91.3%，但即使最强的智能体也只有25.1%的任务能生成既可用又安全的代码，揭示了AI生成代码存在严重的安全隐患。
en_tdlr: The Last Secure Code Benchmark, built from 150 real vulnerabilities with 450 tasks across 7 languages and 3 vibe-coding scenarios, shows that while frontier coding agents achieve 73.6%–91.3% functional pass rates, even the strongest agent produces functional and secure code for only 25.1% of tasks.
